title: Query keys and caching
objective: Design stable structured query keys containing every filter and pass the Query signal to the actual HTTP request.
predict: Switching filters must yield distinct cache entries; reselecting a recent filter can reuse its own result without displaying another filter's rows.
expectedBehavior: Switch between todo and done. Inspect Query Devtools and verify different keys; no cross-filter content leakage. Cancel a request by switching rapidly.
commonFailure: The starter uses a constant cache key for different status-filtered responses.
securityBoundary: Never include access tokens or raw private task titles in a query key; tenant scope belongs in a secure key namespace and server authorization.
